current.text: Ja Morant is no longer on the team. He was traded to Portland, and Memphis got no draft capital for him.
Ty Jerome is expected to start at point guard.
The fifth starting spot is not settled. Joe's projected starting five has Jerami Grant at forward. The depth chart starts Jaylen Wells instead and lists Grant in the second unit.
Cameron Boozer will start. He is expected to do more as the season goes on.
There is little usage competition on the roster, so Cameron Boozer is a top usage option.
The roster is very deep, and coach Tuomas Iisalo runs an 11-man rotation.
Only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward are expected to play more than 30 minutes a game.
The guard group is crowded: Javon Small, Ty Jerome, Scotty Pippen Jr., Campazzo and Cam Spencer compete for minutes.
The forward rotation is crowded with Prosper, Hendricks, Edey and Stewart.
Memphis has far too many players, especially forwards, so more trades or cuts must happen.
Memphis holds three first-round picks in the 2027 draft.
Those picks give Memphis room to make trades, including moving Jerami Grant.
Zach Edey has a broken foot.
Memphis will not be a good team. Joe predicts low to mid 30s wins, around the 10th seed.
Joe says Memphis is not trying to tank this season because of the new tanking rules.
Late-season shutdowns are still a risk. Memphis clearly tanked late last season and shut down Zach Edey, and the team is expected to be weak again.
Memphis has the fewest back-to-backs in the league, so its players have less rest risk.
Memphis has 12 games in fantasy playoff weeks 19 to 21, the most in the league, with one back-to-back pair in each week.

durable.text: Coach Tuomas Iisalo plays at a very high pace.
Iisalo uses short stints of about five minutes and keeps players' minutes down.
Under Iisalo, few players get a full starter's minutes load.
Memphis usually fills its roster with guaranteed contracts for flexibility, then waives players later.

tags.name: roster overload
tags.detail: Too many players, especially forwards and guards; trades or cuts expected, Jerami Grant a trade candidate
tags.new_meaning: The team has more players than rotation spots, so trades or cuts are expected and roles may shift.

note: Memphis is a weak, very fast, deep team where only Cameron Boozer and Cedric Coward are expected to top 30 minutes, so they gain the most. Edey, Jerome, Wells, Grant and the crowded bench guards are held back by short stints and an 11-man rotation. The schedule is the best for us, with the fewest back-to-backs and 12 playoff games, but late-season shutdowns are a risk. Early on, watch who wins the fifth starting spot (Wells or Grant), Edey's broken foot, and any Grant trade or roster cuts.
